daily_window: Decision availability [2024-09-01T00:00Z,2026-09-01T00:00Z); use previous completed daily bar, not future daily close
model: Frozen batch_features_for, EMA34 on BTC and same function with SOL as signal series. No parameter optimization, strategy execution, model fitting, or PnL. Same close>EMA long, else short; ties are short. Full730day warmup retained.
eligibility: Standalone SOL beta/wave/admission eligibility NOT_RECONSTRUCTED; direction count is not trade count, held-position overlap, or executable opportunity.

coefficient_definitions.returns: Daily close-to-close log returns, last90 completed available returns inclusive decision bar; population moments, no future returns
coefficient_definitions.volmatch_k: sigmaBTC/sigmaSOL; equal USD return-vol contribution, ignores correlation
coefficient_definitions.minvariance_k: cov(rBTC,rSOL)/var(rSOL) = rho*sigmaBTC/sigmaSOL; minimizes variance of rBTC-k*rSOL before cost/constraints
coefficient_definitions.inverse_beta_k: 1/betaSOLonBTC = varBTC/cov = sigmaBTC/(rho*sigmaSOL). NOT minvariance except abs(rho)=1; kmin/inversebeta=rho^2
coefficient_definitions.units: If BTC USD notional NB, opposite SOL hedge USD notional NS=k*NB; native quantity NS/SOLmark. Negative/nonfinite k cannot silently become opposite hedge.

design_conflicts: When BTC open and standalone SOL EMA side equals BTC side, it cannot simultaneously be its opposite hedge without an explicit override/filter. Census does not measure actual held overlap.
BTC flat: standalone SOL owns its own cycle/TP/SL/size/admission. BTC opening with existing same-side SOL needs preselected wait/reduce/close/override semantics; no silent flip.

NETTING supports one physical SOL inventory: standalone, original S0 SOL overlay, and new hedge cannot each claim full position. Either exclusive mode or explicit fill-based virtual ownership within one executor is necessary; no parallel PnL/cache authority.
BTC becomes flat: existing hedge disposition must be explicit, no automatic standalone reclassification or invented new rights. Mandatory exits/unknown ACK/partial fills retain native ownership.
Original S0 SOL overlay is an alpha/right lifecycle, not an always-beta-balanced hedge; H4 replacement/addition is a new economic version, not baseline-preserving toggle.
